newsitem.title: GERMANY: M&M and Kirsch Forwarders sign cooperation deal.
newsitem.headline: M&M and Kirsch Forwarders sign cooperation deal.

text.p: German freight forwarder M&M Militzer & Muench GmbH said it has signed a cooperation deal with Canadian company David Kirsch Forwarders Ltd.
The two freight forwarders started working exclusively together for air and sea cargo services in common markets on March 1, an M&M statement said.
Under the agreement, also covering the M&M subsidiaries in eastern Europe and central Asia, clients in Europe would gain improved services to and from Canada, the statement added.
David Kirsch Forwarders is one of the oldest forwarders in Canada, with its head office in Montreal and branches at Montreal airport, Toronto, Winnipeg and Vancouver.
